answer: Sybil resistance rests on bonded collateral escrows: if k identities equivocate with correlated conflicting votes, pairwise evidence supports penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, or O(k²). Upon detection, asymmetric capital depreciation compounds losses across linked stakes, applying an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s capital loss. Ivory, saffron, and basalt may label collateral classes, but splitting identities does not dilute correlated liability.
